interface.defaultPrompt: Check the bridge status, then delegate a small test to my separately signed-in Codex account.
interface.longDescription: Run on the Windows desktop. Check Codex and Claude subscription sign-in, submit one local background task, and retrieve its final answer and provider-reported usage. Codex keeps its dedicated read-only workspace. Claude uses official Claude Code, a dedicated subscription login, no shell or local-file tools, and optional public web research. No paid API fallback or Google integration is configured. Computer must stay awake and online. Subscription allowances remain separate; a dedicated login folder alone does not prove a different account.
interface.shortDescription: Use your Codex and Claude plans

name: farhan-agent-bridge
description: Delegate local tasks through existing Codex and Claude subscriptions, with separate authentication and retrieved results.
